decisions.instruction: Retain the existing fresh flower-pad constructions. The Rose Heart is approved as-is; the Sunny Diamond is also accepted without a new source pass.
Replace the literal clubs glyph with an unmistakable botanical four-leaf clover while keeping the flower-pad family and making the emblem-edge glow brighter and clearer.
Replace the literal playing-card spade with a more original stylised Puzzlewild emblem that remains pair-readable, and make its emblem-edge glow brighter and clearer.
Preserve the approved sprite unchanged and reclassify the courteous green-tea-drinking skeleton as a rescue-and-collect friend, never an enemy or guardian.
All other new and additional refreshed sprites presented before this response are source-design and rendering approved. This does not itself publish runtime derivatives or retire rollback assets.

approvalBoundary: Source-design approval does not waive alpha, registration, provenance, rights, catalogue, performance, build or runtime-publication gates. The new Batch 19 clover and spade outputs remain pending a later Human review.
